reviewer: root independent source, ownership and immutable receipt review
review_scope: Fixed W3C context validation, bounded tracestate and no baggage forwarding
Engine-owned native tracing dispatcher applied for each poll; no span guard across await
Explicit opt-in ActivitySource/Meter and optional ILogger; no default exporter or global runtime
Disabled path avoids request diagnostic state; low-cardinality fixed tags and redacted failure categories
Metadata queue enforces entry/byte/per-item caps including in-flight export; blocked exporter retains only bounded metadata and cannot extend the independent250ms flush deadline
Close/freeze detaches native ownership from observer sampling; native cancellation reason retains deadline classification
Actual Content-Length success regression discovered through public sample fixed in B17 and focused-tested for HTTP1/HTTP2 before final receipt
Matched whole-process costs include test client/observers; no superiority or zero-overhead claim
